name: Bluesky PDS
description: Self-hosted Personal Data Server (PDS) for Bluesky (AT Protocol). This installer builds and runs the PDS Node service directly (no Docker) and installs Caddy to listen on high ports (8080/8443).

notes.text: This installer runs the PDS service directly (Node.js) and installs Caddy to listen on high ports (8080/8443). Forward host ports 80->8080 and 443->8443 to the container (host-level NAT) so HTTP/TLS validation and external access work correctly.
You must create DNS A records for your domain and wildcard (*.domain) before installation.
